description.value: The study developed standardized alcohol-associated cues and assessed cue-induced brain activation with fMRI in abstinent alcoholics.

spans.text: The objective of this study was to develop new standardized alcohol-associated cues and assess their effects on brain activation with functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI).

description.value: The study included abstinent alcohol-dependent patients and healthy volunteers; a pilot fMRI study presented alcohol-associated and abstract pictures to six abstinent alcoholics.

spans.text: In the fMRI pilot study, alcohol and abstract pictures were presented to six abstinent alcoholics
Fifteen standardized alcohol-associated stimuli and 15 abstract pictures with the same color and complexity were presented to six abstinent alcoholics in a block design.
